title: Курсы для будущих родителей  (Prenatal Classes for Expectant Parents)

segments.t: While Nastya admits to a horrified Kostya that she blabbed to Katya, Max disguises himself as an expectant father at Elena Vladimirovna's childbirth seminar—where a graphic birthing demonstration makes him faint.
Заходим по одному, ведём себя спокойно.
Как у тебя дела, всё хорошо?
Тебе на это ещё всю жизнь смотреть.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'You promised, after all.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'you' and finishing on 'promised'.
Заходим по одному, ведём себя спокойно.
'Come in one by one, behave calmly.' In Russian, the idea of 'we go inside' flows naturally into 'calmly' without extra filler words.
'The atmosphere here is tense enough already.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'here' and finishing on 'atmosphere'.
Как у тебя дела, всё хорошо?
'How are you doing, is everything fine?' the doctor anchors the line on 'how', while 'well' completes the thought.
'Now then, where are you going?' The grammar packs 'so' and 'got ready' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
Тебе на это ещё всю жизнь смотреть.
'You still have to look at this your whole life.' the doctor brings out the contrast between 'to you' and 'on' in a few short words.
'Quiet, quiet, we breathe.' the doctor anchors the line on 'quieter', while 'we breathe' completes the thought.
'Good job, good job, we breathe.' The grammar packs 'well done' and 'we breathe' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Max answers right away.
'I need to talk with the doctor.' The meaning hinges on 'to me' working together with 'doctor' in spoken Russian.
'Step closer, do not be shy.' In Russian, the idea of 'suit' flows naturally into 'are shy' without extra filler words.
'I suddenly started feeling dizzy.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'to me' and finishing on 'badly'. the doctor answers right away.
'Help him up quickly!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'lift up' before landing on 'quickly'. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Заходим по одному, ведём себя спокойно.
Как у тебя дела, всё хорошо?
Тебе на это ещё всю жизнь смотреть.
Overwhelmed by the childbirth simulation, Max collapses onto the floor before he can ask the doctor about Vika's due date. See you in the next scene.
